dish.note: Baked cheesecake on a biscuit base, with a warm berry sauce.
dish.how: Crush 250g plain sweet biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a 22cm springform tin. Beat 750g cream cheese with 180g sugar, then beat in 3 eggs one at a time, 200g sour cream, 1 tsp vanilla and the juice of half a lemon until smooth. Pour over the base and bake at 160C for 55 minutes until set with a slight wobble, then turn off the oven and cool inside for 30 minutes. Chill at least 3 hours. Simmer 300g frozen berries with 2 tbsp sugar for 6 minutes and spoon over each slice.

steps.text: Crush the biscuits, mix with the melted butter and press into the tin.
Beat the cream cheese and sugar, then the eggs, sour cream, vanilla and lemon juice.
Pour onto the base and bake at 160C until set with a slight wobble.
Turn the oven off and cool the cake inside.
Simmer the berries with the sugar and spoon over each slice.

dish.make_ahead: Make the day before; it needs at least 3 hours in the fridge
